scope: Preserve actual development findings, observed failures, corrections and remaining limits. This record grants no phase acceptance and is not a new execution report. Qualification and acceptance are recorded separately in this packet.
severity_policy: Only severities explicitly assigned by the originating report are retained. Null means the source report did not assign an F level; it does not mean F0.

findings.title: Provisional split input repeated its eight-row blocks
findings.problem: The provisional split formula repeated both eight-row input blocks because 8*3+1 is divisible by five, weakening repeated/swapped output-block detection.
findings.correction: Use ((3*r + 2*k + 3*(r//8)) % 5) - 2 before generating the first fixture. No accepted fixture or tolerance was changed.
validation: Producer asserts row-block distinction before generation.
Independent serialized-input tests check that output halves cannot repeat or swap.
Frozen provenance review reconstructed every input family, including the revised row-block term.

findings.title: Alternate-root check could pin a different producer than it used
findings.problem: After changing a copied producer W1 seed from 0x50403401 to 0x50403403, the outer checker wrote and accepted a manifest for the old fixture while pinning the changed target producer.
findings.correction: Compare the target checker, reference producer and encoding-helper bytes against the actual invoking modules before generating expectations. Intentional source changes use the reviewed target own checker; no target code is imported for this identity check.
validation: Independent review executed nine subprocess probes; copied producer/checker/helper mismatches fail even after their manifest digests are refreshed.
All six mismatch rejection paths preserved temporary-file bytes and modification times; identical copies and reviewed target-own changes remain supported.
limits: Source consistency is not authentication, a concurrent-mutation guarantee or an import sandbox.

findings.title: Normative specifications were not pinned and one sentence overstated source evidence
findings.problem: The named tiny-MLP and tensor-numerics specifications could drift outside the manifest inventory; one sentence described fixture data as establishing execution correctness.
findings.correction: Pin both normative specifications and describe the data as correctness targets for later execution. Clarify tensor-transfer exclusions and future actual-output/completion obligations.
validation: Frozen review verified all 17 final artifact pins, including both specifications.
Reviewed specification and executor plan distinguish source targets, host work, tensor-buffer byte estimates and later measured execution.

findings.title: Host output-copy token disagreed between fixture and graph
findings.problem: Fixture host_work used output_row_assembly while the manifest graph and allowlist used copy_row_blocks. No current executor existed, but a future consumer could disagree between the contracts.
findings.correction: Use copy_row_blocks in the producer, regenerate the fixture explicitly and add cross-document token equality coverage.
validation: All 44 raw tensor hashes over 4,000 uint32 words remained identical after the metadata-only correction.
The 19 focused reference tests passed; an independent reviewer recomputed tensor identities.

findings.title: Spec-only edits would not trigger the governance workflow
findings.problem: Both governance event filters omitted the two newly pinned design specifications; the combined implementation change triggered CI but later spec-only edits would not.
findings.correction: Add both exact paths to push and pull_request filters, four positive lines total, and dynamically test coverage of all pinned artifacts.
validation: After the fix, both focused tests passed.
Independent review proved removing only the four additions reproduces the baseline workflow byte for byte.
All 17 final manifest pins, the workflow and its test are covered by both event filters.
The extracted baseline classifier classified the frozen change R2, with no R3 contracts or workflow trust exposures.

findings.title: Manifest regeneration accepted native-incompatible profile settings
findings.problem: The old subset check accepted disabled FP16/local memory, PE ratio 2, and an extra local-memory-size override of 8192 after explicit manifest regeneration, while the actual native profile guard rejected each generated configuration.
findings.correction: Validate exact typed mappings for all 26 core and two chip settings; reject extra configuration keys, platform overrides, inheritance and unknown top-level fields. Pin the native guard, configuration defaults, type definitions and parser; leave descriptive metadata separately permitted.
validation: Seven new tests cover 15 independent semantic mutations after updating each copied profile digest.
All 30 check/write rejection invocations preserved copied bytes and mtimes.
The complete contract module passed 32 tests in the isolated copied bundle.
Independent profile review verified actual parser merge/inheritance behavior, final 17 source pins, and unchanged native configuration/guard files.
limits: Pins and mapping checks establish source consistency, not generated-build, runtime-override or backend/kernel agreement. Future executor qualification must establish those separately.

findings.title: CI regression guard missed legal quoted or padded control keys
findings.problem: The new test accepted job-level if : false, single-quoted if: false, and continue-on-error : true, even though these legal YAML forms can skip or suppress the governance job. The current workflow itself was unconditional.
findings.correction: Require plain job-level mapping keys at the existing indentation; reject duplicates, if, continue-on-error, and unsupported quoted/padded/merge/explicit-key forms.
validation: Twelve in-memory mutation probes were rejected; baseline and a harmless plain name field were accepted.
Both focused tests passed after repair.
An independent changed-hunk reviewer separately replayed all three original bypasses; each was rejected.
The workflow bytes were unchanged by the guard repair.
limits: This is a conservative guard for the current workflow subset, not a general YAML parser or a security guarantee for an arbitrary rewritten workflow.

findings.title: Inherited tensor DSP area gate remains failed
findings.problem: Three existing full CI runs report tensor DSP usage 267 to 283, shown as +6.0%, beyond the unchanged 5% limit. The latest audited run had 125 passing jobs plus failed logic_gate and aggregate jobs.
findings.disposition: No RTL, golden baseline or gate threshold is changed by the fixture work. The green predecessor run 44258576211 had 42 jobs and no logic_gate cell; reduced green coverage does not resolve this failure.

static_candidate.description: Widened MX scale indexing also widens a dynamic multiplication. Additional DSP inference is plausible.

findings.follow_up: Establish parent/candidate Beacon measurements and per-unit attribution; preserve the widened index, prove any addressing rewrite equivalent, and run MX WGMMA NRC=16 RTL coverage with applicable SimX/RTL parity.

findings.title: P01-A03 vendor hardware-emulation prerequisite remains blocked
findings.problem: Qualified vendor XRT hw_emu tools/platform and matching integration artifacts are unavailable or unverified in the retained P01-A03 record.
findings.disposition: P01-A01/A02 remain accepted; the blocked A03 record is preserved. Source-only P04 work does not replace vendor integration, and P07 still requires full P01 completion.
findings.follow_up: Establish the identified vendor release/platform, matching xclbin and emconfig, tool identities and resource budget, then execute and independently review the bounded XRT hw_emu integration smoke.

findings.title: Qualification harness can omit an early blocked receipt
findings.reported_evidence: static proof and isolated no-process preflight probe
findings.problem: When run_bounded blocks before creating a log, the outer harness calls log.read_bytes before appending the blocked receipt. FileNotFoundError prevents that latest record from being saved.
findings.disposition: The harness fails nonzero and cannot grant a false pass. None of the completed qualification commands inspected by the reporter took this path. Preserve the exact executed harness and disclose the limitation; the finding does not alter the P04 implementation.
findings.follow_up: Before adapting the harness for the next qualification, persist a returned blocked receipt even when no log exists, use an explicit absent-log identity, and exercise early disk/resource/log-open failures in isolated no-process probes. Keep the historical executed harness unchanged.

provenance_retention: Original names and SHA-256 values identify inspected development receipts/probes. Compact observations are embedded in this record. These names do not assert separately delivered raw files; completed agent reports are retained by the packet agent ledger.
